about: `on` after `all` in a role the actor gives up says where the things go, not what holds them: the table here is no container, so `drop all on the table`, the cakes in hand, is answered as `drop [item] on [surface]` read in part, never `not_here`; `drop all from the table` still narrows.

expect.words: There is nothing special about the tea room.
You can't drop the red cake on the table.
